current_events: Qatar's foreign ministry says that they are working to resume ceasefire negotiations between Iran and the United States
Qatar as a mediator in conflict

Ukrainian forces launch a massive drone attack on Moscow Oblast, Russia, with more than 1,600 long-range drones launched from Ukraine. At least two people are killed with hundreds more evacuated while Moscow Refinery is on fire following several direct hits

Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirms he ordered the attack on Moscow in response to Russian forces targeting civilians in Ukrainian cities, saying that FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles and ballistic missiles were also used in the attack
Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war

The Statistical Center of Iran reports that the country's gross domestic product contracted 10.1% year-on-year from late March to late June, during the war, amid longstanding sanctions and currency depreciation
Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war

The National Hurricane Center reports that Tropical Depression Six strengthened into Tropical Storm Fay amidst an unusually quiet Atlantic hurricane season caused by El Niño, becoming the sixth named storm of the season
2026 Atlantic hurricane season
The Democratic Republic of the Congo launches vaccinations for frontline workers amdist the Ebola outbreak in the country

Iranian authorities seal a French language centre affiliated with the French embassy in Tehran under a judicial order. Prosecutors say it operated without a licence and conducted activities against Iranian culture and national security
Haiti sends 18 suspects in the July 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moïse to the United States to face federal charges related to the killing
Assassination of Jovenel Moïse, Haiti–United States relations

Pakistani police arrest businesswoman Aleema Khan, sister of jailed former prime minister Imran Khan, at her home in Lahore, Punjab, one week before his Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party's planned protest march. Police and the government do not state a reason for the arrest
Four unauthorized miners are killed in a shooting targeting a vehicle by unidentified gunmen in Barkin Ladi, Plateau State, Nigeria

One child is killed and two others are injured in a stabbing attack in the Blue Mountains of New South Wales, Australia. The children's mother, who was also hospitalised with injuries, is the chief suspect
State elections are held in Germany for the Landtag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and the Berlin House of Representatives, with an expected decline for the Chancellor Friedrich Merz's party, the CDU
2026 Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state election, 2026 Berlin state election
Japanese triathlete Takumi Hojo wins the first gold medal of the 2026 Asian Games
Japan at the 2026 Asian Games, Triathlon at the 2026 Asian Games

In cycling, Belgian rider Remco Evenepoel becomes the first person to win four consecutive Road World Championship titles in the men's individual time trial event and equals Fabian Cancellara and Tony Martin's joint record for the most titles. Swiss rider Marlen Reusser wins the women's time trial event
2026 UCI Road World Championships
